newsitem.title: USA: Hilton closes 5-yr, $1.75 bln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: Hilton closes 5-yr, $1.75 bln credit pact.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp said Monday it has completed an agreement giving it a five-year , $1.75 billion revolving credit line.
The banking facility was arranged by J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, and it consolidates and increases Hilton's credit line from a previous $600 million.
It will be used primarily for the acquisition of hotel and gaming properties and general corporate purposes.
The undrawn facility fee is 8.5 basis points with the all-in drawn costs at LIBOR-plus-25 basis points.
